newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 8.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 8.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Tuesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Clear skies and warm weather with maximum winds 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to seven feet high. Moderate rains along most of the coast.
Generally clear skies with winds generally 10 to 15 knots and waves three to five feet high.
Light and moderate rains along the coasts of Central America. Winds from 10 to 15 knots and waves four to seven feet high.
